boundary_counterexample.explanation: A failed attempt could cost 200, while the 0.25 ledger has at most 75 extra units without reuse. No attempt is funded. SafeProjected pays 300, equal to agent service. Earliest pays 3 agent services plus successful compilation at 2, total 5. This is no violation of the agent-relative guarantee.
boundary_counterexample.model: one family; c=1; d=0; C=2; C_fail=200; p=1; q=0; pi=1; h=0; m=tau0=0; n=300; k_min=3

design.boundary: All 240 single-family price/horizon conditions with 3 repetitions; retained separately.
design.fresh_grid: All 300 changed conditions have the same 3 x 4 x 5 x 5 structure, eight paired repetitions, 1800 arrivals, and 40 recurrent families except sparse generation. Admission p is 0.95, 0.35, 0, or a per-family mixture over {0,0.05,0.3,0.7,1}. Changed worlds use failure cost x3, both compilation prices x7, h=0.07, and m=910; base parameters match the original grid. Inherited world labels are not literal parameter values. Changes were selected before round-two evaluation but after round one; exploratory evidence, not independent confirmation of final selection.
design.known_development: 27 previously inspected synthetic cells, first 10 saved paired repetitions; retained separately and not counted as independent validation.
design.original_grid: All 300 original cells = 3 model profiles x 4 admission settings x 5 arrival patterns x 5 cost/drift/routing worlds, retrospectively crosschecked for 22 policies. Eight paired repetitions, 1200 arrivals, 30 recurrent families except sparse generation. Admission p is 0.9, 0.5, 0, or a per-family mixture over {0,0.1,0.5,0.9,1}. Patterns are uniform labels (named poisson in code), Zipf, bursts, regime shift, and sparse. Base h=0.02, m=91, tau0=368, TTL=100. Worlds are base, failure cost x5, both compilation prices x5, h=0.1, and m=1820.
design.real_arrivals: 3 models x 4 existing arrival logs x 10 paired repetitions. Costs mapped to family IDs and admission probabilities assigned independently of original admission labels. These are simulations on existing recurrence patterns, not 12 deployment studies.
design.scope_warning: The old 109-cell paper_revision_20260922 study evaluates projected_cap, not SafeProjected. Its result table cannot be relabeled as the new method.

metric_definitions.bootstrap: 2000 percentile resamples of 10 existing paired repetition indices, seed 20260922017; a draw uses the same indices for all 22 policies and all 12 real-log cells. Percentiles use linear interpolation. No new simulation, task stream, model call, or cost-profile sample.
metric_definitions.bootstrap_scope: Conditional uncertainty over retained mappings and simulator random outcomes for these four fixed logs and supplied cost profiles. Does not cover measurement uncertainty, alternative logs, policy selection, or population deployment frequencies.
metric_definitions.cost_per_success: mean_rep(rows[p].cost) / (arrivals * mean_rep(rows[p].quality)); ratio of totals across repetitions, not mean of run-level cost per success.
metric_definitions.max_prefix_ratio: max over stored rows[p][rep].prefix_ratio; each field is the engine's maximum K_t/A_t over completed arrival prefixes. Null means the source did not record this metric.
metric_definitions.mean_ratio_agent: Arithmetic mean of ratio_agent over all cells in the named panel, giving every cell equal weight; every model has 4 real-log cells or 100 grid cells.
metric_definitions.mean_success_rate: mean_rep(rows[p].quality); raw quality = successes / arrivals, as set by the simulator.
metric_definitions.normalization: Cost is in each model's price-weighted input-token units supplied by the original measurement reader. Absolute units are never pooled across models.
metric_definitions.pair_comparison: Each ratio uses stored per-cell mean costs for SafeProjected-0.25 and the named comparator, then receives equal weight across cells; tied means within 1e-9 in cost ratio.
metric_definitions.prefix_exact_overshoot_runs: Count saved runs above the exact 1+epsilon ratio, including harmless implementation-tolerance overshoots; reported separately from tolerance violations.
metric_definitions.prefix_recorded_runs: Number of saved per-run maximum-prefix records, not number of newly simulated runs or individually reread prefixes.
metric_definitions.prefix_tolerance_violation_runs: Count saved runs with max_prefix_ratio > (1+epsilon)*(1+1e-8)+1e-12. All retained A_t>=1; implementation tolerance in cost is 1e-8*max(1,(1+epsilon)*A_t).
metric_definitions.quality_scope: All reported panels use silent=0 and fallback_mult=1. Detected failures use the paired agent outcome, so no-quality-loss relative to agent is built into this simulator. This is not independent deployment-quality evidence.
metric_definitions.ratio_agent: mean_rep(rows[p].cost) / mean_rep(rows[reactive].cost), not mean_rep of cost ratios; denominator includes supplied agent cost c_f and common router tau0.
metric_definitions.ratio_best22: mean_rep(rows[p].cost) / min over all 22 policies of mean_rep(rows[policy].cost); descriptive finite-rule best, not OPT or an executable comparator.
metric_definitions.raw_cost: rows[policy][rep].cost = sum(rows[policy][rep].components[k] for k in reactive_tokens, extraction_tokens, compile_tokens, router_tokens); excludes penalty/harm.
metric_definitions.twice_safe_cells: Count cells with comparator mean cost / SafeProjected-0.25 mean cost >= 2, not a probability or guarantee.
